claim: CloudFront flat-rate plans, launched on November 18, 2025, come in Free ($0/month), Pro ($15/month), Business ($200/month) and Premium tiers for new and existing CloudFront distributions.
note: Adjudicated 2026-10-12: the Premium price was dropped from the claim. A currency vote found that since 2026-05-12 Premium has configurable usage levels ($1,000 is only the default level; the CloudFront guide's 'Premium usage levels' table is not saved as an evidence snapshot). Teach the Premium price only from a CloudFront chapter fact.
